candidates.reason: Rearranged into a left-to-right banner, but the logo floats alone in a dead left zone. The headline and subhead have different left edges, and there is a big empty gap between them. The Shop Now pill crowds the right edge and does not line up with the text block. The can sits in a large, unused band.

This is the tall original shrunk into the middle of the wide canvas. The logo, subhead and button text are microscopic and unreadable, and the subhead wraps badly. About 80% of the canvas is empty background with stray bokeh, and the layout ignores the banner format entirely.

Almost identical to candidate 1, with the same flaws. The logo is isolated far left. The headline and subhead start at different left edges with a loose gap between them. The CTA is jammed toward the right edge and sits beside the subhead instead of being grouped with it, and the spacing across the canvas is uneven.

Clearest hierarchy and best use of the format: the logo sits above a centered headline, the subhead is on one line, and the CTA is prominent on the right. Still, the can is pushed against the left with tight margins and looks cut off from the group. The CTA is centered higher than the headline and subhead, so it sits on no shared axis, and the right side feels heavier than the left.
